stances.quote: As a constitutionalist, I believe that our nation's security from all threats, both foreign and domestic, is the government's core responsibility.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly frames national security and defense as government's core responsibility and praises a defense readiness act.

stances.quote: America’s problem is not that we tax too little, but that we spend far too much. I will not vote to increase taxes.
stances.reasoning: Text directly states opposition to tax increases and attributes problems to spending rather than insufficient taxation.

stances.quote: Spending Cuts and Debt Admiral Mike Mullen, former Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, stated that the national debt is the biggest threat to our national security.
stances.reasoning: Text identifies national debt as top security threat and commits to spending cuts and no tax increases.
No statements on tariffs, protectionism, or free trade appear in the text.
No statements on foreign aid spending levels appear in the text.

stances.quote: America needs health care reform to lower costs, increase access, and enhance patient choice, and as your Congressman, I am committed to reform that is both patient-centered and market-based.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly endorses market-based, patient-centered reform and opposes the ACA's government mandates.
No statements on campaign finance limits or political spending appear in the text.
